title: Interview with Jan Pesman on an architectural model of the Heiwo System, Delft, 15 April 2016
descriptions: The interview was conducted as part of the MA programme in Conservation an Restoration of Cultural Heritage at the University of Amsterdam. It concerns the conservation of an architectural model of the Heiwo System, created by architect Jan Pesman at the end of his studies at the University of Technology Delft. The model is in the collection of the Cultural Heritage Agency of the Netherlands.
